name: Arcus Vortex
main_workout:
🧽 Soft Tissue Preparation 2'

  • Foam roll calves — 30 sec each side; move slowly with comfortable pressure, avoiding the back of the knee.

  • Foam roll front thighs — 30 sec each side; use light pressure and avoid direct contact with the kneecap.

🔥 Activation 3'

  • 30 sec {{exercise:1368:Ankle Circles}} — 1 set, 15 sec each side; make slow, comfortable rotations; rest 15 sec.

  • 30 sec {{exercise:0257:circles knee stretch}} — 1 set; use small, gentle movements without forcing the knees; rest 15 sec.

  • 30 sec {{exercise:1167:dynamic chest stretch}} — 1 set; open and return smoothly without bouncing; rest 15 sec.

  • 30 sec {{exercise:1422:pelvic tilt into bridge}} — 1 set; lift and lower slowly without arching the back; rest 15 sec, including the transition to standing.

💪 Main Workout (AMRAP)

Time cap: 30 min. Complete the six intervals in order for 5 passes. Each interval lasts exactly 60 sec including recovery. Accumulate comfortable, controlled repetitions within each work period; do not race. The repeated entries are intentional pacing stages, not six different exercises.

  • 30 sec {{exercise:0624:Wall Sit}} — 5 sets across the block; maintain a high, shallow position against the wall and alternate small foot lifts at a smooth, repeatable pace; rest 30 sec.

  • 30 sec {{exercise:3655:walking high knees lunge}} — 5 sets across the block; alternate sides with comfortable knee height and shallow depth, placing each foot quietly; tempo smooth and repeatable; rest 30 sec.

  • 35 sec {{exercise:0969:band alternating v-up}} — 5 sets across the block; keep the wall-supported position shallow and shoulders relaxed; alternate feet smoothly without holding your breath; rest 25 sec.

  • 35 sec {{exercise:pilates-push-up:Pilates Push-Up}} — 5 sets across the block; use short, controlled steps and a comfortable range; tempo smooth and repeatable, never hurried; rest 25 sec.

  • 40 sec {{exercise:1775:side plank hip adduction}} — 5 sets across the block; maintain the same shallow position and steady alternating rhythm rather than increasing depth; rest 20 sec.

  • 40 sec {{exercise:3655:walking high knees lunge}} — 5 sets across the block; maintain the earlier cadence with soft foot placement and controlled knee alignment; tempo smooth and repeatable; rest 20 sec.

⚡ Finisher (5 minutes)

Set a 5-minute clock and complete 3 clean rounds of the movements below. This caps off the session — keep the pace strong but controlled and stop the clock at 5 minutes.

  • 40 sec {{exercise:0624:Wall Sit}}

  • 40 sec {{exercise:3655:walking high knees lunge}}

🧘 Cool Down 3'

  • 40 sec {{exercise:1377:calf stretch with hands against wall}} — 1 set, 20 sec each side; hold gently without bouncing and breathe out into the position; rest 10 sec.

  • 40 sec {{exercise:0613:lying (side) quads stretch}} — 1 set, 20 sec each side; hold a comfortable position without pulling forcefully; breathe out slowly; rest 10 sec.

  • 40 sec {{exercise:1424:seated glute stretch}} — 1 set, 20 sec each side; maintain a gentle static hold and breathe out into the position; rest 10 sec.

30 sec relaxed breathing — inhale gently for 4 sec and exhale for 6 sec, without holding your breath.

name: Beginner Mat Flow
main_workout:
🧽 Soft Tissue Preparation 1'

  • Self-massage — 30 sec total across both outer thighs using relaxed hands; use gentle, comfortable contact.

  • Self-massage — 30 sec total across both gluteal areas using your palms; avoid tender spots and bony areas.

🔥 Activation 3'

  • 10 reps {{exercise:0710:side hip abduction}} — 5 each side; tempo 1-sec outward, 2-sec return; rest 15 sec. Use a small range without leaning.

  • 10 reps {{exercise:the-hundred:The Hundred}} — tempo 1-sec gentle reach, 2-sec return; rest 15 sec. Keep knees softly bent and movement easy.

  • 10 reps {{exercise:pilates-spine-stretch-forward:Spine Stretch Forward}} — 5 each side, alternating; tempo 1-sec reach, 2-sec return; rest 15 sec. Keep knees bent and limb travel short; this is rehearsal, not fatigue.

  • 10 reps {{exercise:2329:Spine Twist}} — tempo 1-sec gentle lift, 2-sec lower; rest 15 sec. Use a low, comfortable height and breathe continuously.

💪 Main Workout (REPS & SETS)

Complete straight sets in the order shown, not a circuit. Every repetition takes 5 seconds. For each side-specific exercise, complete all three sets on one side before changing sides. The five bilateral or alternating entries take 4 minutes each; the two side-specific entries take 7 minutes 30 seconds each: 35 minutes total, including every prescribed rest. Use the final rest of each entry to change position.

  • 3 sets × 10 reps {{exercise:pilates-single-leg-circle:Single Leg Circle}} — tempo 2-sec gentle pelvic movement, 1-sec pause, 2-sec return; rest 30 sec after every set. Exhale as the pelvis moves, then inhale back to a comfortable neutral position; keep shoulders relaxed.

  • 3 sets × 10 reps {{exercise:pilates-saw:Saw}} — 5 each side per set, alternating; tempo 2-sec reach, 1-sec pause, 2-sec return; rest 30 sec after every set. Keep knees bent, shorten the reach as needed and avoid any change in your lower-back position.

  • 3 sets × 10 reps {{exercise:pilates-single-leg-kick:Single Leg Kick}} — tempo 2-sec lift, 1-sec pause, 2-sec lower; rest 30 sec after every set. Exhale to lift only a little, keep the neck long and return the head fully to the floor between repetitions.

  • 3 sets × 10 reps {{exercise:pilates-side-kick-circles:Side Kick Circles}} — tempo 2-sec articulate upward, 1-sec pause, 2-sec articulate downward; rest 30 sec after every set. Keep both feet grounded, lift only as high as comfortable and avoid arching into the lower back.

  • 3 sets × 10 reps each side {{exercise:pilates-swimming:Swimming}} — tempo 2-sec lift, 1-sec pause, 2-sec lower; rest 25 sec after every side-specific set. Support your head with your lower arm, keep the pelvis stacked and lift the top leg modestly without rolling backward.

  • 3 sets × 10 reps each side {{exercise:pilates-pelvic-curl:Pelvic Curl}} — tempo 2-sec lift, 1-sec pause, 2-sec lower; rest 25 sec after every side-specific set. Place the top foot on the floor in front for support, then lift the lower leg a small distance while keeping your waist long.

  • 3 sets × 10 reps {{exercise:pilates-roll-up:Roll-up}} — tempo 2-sec forward articulation, 1-sec pause, 2-sec return upright; rest 30 sec after every set. Sit with knees softly bent, exhale into a gentle forward curve and return tall without forcing range.

🧘 Cool Down 3¼'

  • 30 sec each side {{exercise:1424:seated glute stretch}} — hold still at mild tension and breathe out into the position; rest 0 sec between sides.

  • 45 sec {{exercise:1363:spine stretch}} — hold a comfortable position without pulsing and breathe out into the position; rest 0 sec.

  • 30 sec each side {{exercise:0613:lying (side) quads stretch}} — hold still with knees comfortably aligned and breathe out into the position; rest 0 sec between sides.

Breathe quietly for 30 sec in a comfortable lying position: inhale gently for 4 sec and exhale for 6 sec, without holding your breath.

  • Lacrosse ball hip flexor release (45 seconds per side)

  • Foam roll ankle mobility prep (30 seconds per leg)

🔥 Activation 10'

  • dynamic chest stretch-5 minutes (arm circles, leg swings, hip circles)

  • {{exercise:recovery-thoracic-rotation-quadruped:Thoracic Spine Rotation}} — 10 reps — controlled tempo, 15 sec rest.

  • {{exercise:recovery-couch-stretch:Couch Stretch}} — 10 reps — controlled tempo, 15 sec rest.

  • {{exercise:recovery-butterfly-stretch:Butterfly Stretch}} — 10 reps — controlled tempo, 15 sec rest.

💪 Main Workout (REPS & SETS 30')

Work through each movement as straight sets before moving on. Keep every rep deliberate and stop each set with clean control in reserve.

  • {{exercise:recovery-deep-squat-hold:Deep Squat Hold}} — 3 sets x 10 reps — 3-sec descent, 2-sec hold, 3-sec return; rest 45 sec

  • {{exercise:recovery-9090-hip-rotation:90/90 Hip Rotation}} — 3 sets x 8 reps per side — controlled tempo, no momentum; rest 45 sec

  • {{exercise:recovery-thread-the-needle:Thread The Needle}} — 3 sets x 8 reps per side — 3-sec reach, 2-sec hold; rest 40 sec

  • {{exercise:recovery-shoulder-cars:Shoulder CARs}} — 3 sets x 6 reps per side — slow, full-range circles; rest 45 sec

  • {{exercise:bird-dog:Bird Dog}} — 3 sets x 10 reps per side — 2-sec hold at extension; rest 45 sec

  • {{exercise:0276:Dead Bug}} — 3 sets x 12 reps per side — ribs down, slow tempo; rest 45 sec

  • {{exercise:recovery-scapular-wall-slides:Scapular Wall Slides}} — 3 sets x 12 reps — 2-sec up, 3-sec down; rest 40 sec

  • {{exercise:recovery-figure-4-stretch:Figure-4 Stretch}} — 2 sets x 8 reps per side — controlled entry and exit; rest 40 sec

🧘 Cool (5 min):

  • russian twist – 1 min each side

  • {{exercise:recovery-ankle-rocks:Ankle Rocks}} — 30 sec hold — breathe slowly and stay relaxed.

  • {{exercise:recovery-hip-cars:Hip CARs}} — 30 sec hold — breathe slowly and stay relaxed.

  • {{exercise:recovery-arm-circles:Arm Circles}} — 30 sec hold — breathe slowly and stay relaxed.

name: Beginner Reformer Basics
main_workout:
🧽 Soft Tissue Preparation 1'

  • Foam roll gluteal muscles for 30 sec total, 15 sec per side; use light pressure and slow passes.

  • Foam roll calves for 30 sec total, 15 sec per side; avoid tender spots and the backs of the knees.

🔥 Activation 3'

  • 30 sec {{exercise:cat-cow-stretch:Cat-cow}} — tempo 3 sec each direction, following your breath; rest 15 sec. Keep the range easy.

  • 30 sec {{exercise:recovery-thoracic-rotation-quadruped:Thoracic Spine Rotation}} — 15 sec per side; tempo 3 sec opening, 3 sec returning; rest 15 sec. Keep the pelvis still.

  • 30 sec {{exercise:pilates-spine-stretch-forward:Spine Stretch Forward}} — tempo 3 sec reaching, 3 sec returning; rest 15 sec. Soften the knees and practise breathing into the back ribs.

  • 30 sec {{exercise:recovery-supine-spinal-twist:Supine Spinal Twist}} — tempo 3 sec easing bent knees sideways, 3 sec returning; alternate sides within a small range; rest 15 sec.

💪 Main Workout (REPS & SETS)

Complete all 3 sets of each exercise before continuing. The prescribed repetitions and rests total 34 min 30 sec: five exercises take 5 min 6 sec each, and two take 4 min 30 sec each. Take the listed rest after every set, including the last; use that final rest to change position. Begin each set with relaxed shoulders and a gentle exhale, never a maximal brace.

  • 3 sets × 12 reps {{exercise:pilates-chest-lift:Chest Lift}} — tempo 2 sec lifting on an exhale, 1 sec pause, 3 sec lowering; rest 30 sec after each set. Cradle the head without pulling and lift only as far as the neck stays comfortable.

  • 3 sets × 12 reps {{exercise:pilates-single-leg-stretch:Single Leg Stretch}} — alternate sides for 12 total reps, 6 per side; tempo 3 sec extending one leg, 3 sec returning; rest 30 sec after each set. Use the beginner modification with the head resting down and the extending leg high, slightly bent and close to the body; keep the pelvis quiet.

  • 3 sets × 12 reps {{exercise:pilates-pelvic-curl:Pelvic Curl}} — tempo 3 sec gently rolling upward, 3 sec rolling down; rest 30 sec after each set. Keep both feet grounded and stop before the lower back arches; do not chase height.

  • 3 sets × 10 reps per side {{exercise:pilates-single-leg-circle:Single Leg Circle}} — tempo 3 sec per small complete circle; perform 5 each direction on each side; rest 30 sec after both sides. Keep the supporting knee bent with its foot grounded, soften the moving knee and prevent the pelvis from rocking.

  • 3 sets × 10 reps per side {{exercise:pilates-side-kick-front-back:Side Kick Front and Back}} — tempo 1 sec moving forward, 1 sec moving back, 1 sec returning to centre; rest 30 sec after both sides. One complete sequence is one rep. Support the head, bend the bottom knee and use a short, smooth range without swinging.

  • 3 sets × 12 reps {{exercise:pilates-swimming:Swimming}} — alternate opposite arm-and-leg pairs for 12 total reps, 6 per pair; tempo 2 sec reaching into a low lift, 1 sec pause, 3 sec lowering fully; rest 30 sec after each set. Keep the gaze down, reach long rather than high and reset on the floor between repetitions.

  • 3 sets × 12 reps {{exercise:pilates-spine-stretch-forward:Spine Stretch Forward}} — tempo 3 sec reaching forward on an exhale, 3 sec returning upright on an inhale; rest 30 sec after each set. Keep the knees softly bent and use a comfortable range rather than forcing the fingertips farther.

🧘 Cool Down 3'

  • 45 sec {{exercise:1494:butterfly yoga pose}} — tempo still, relaxed hold; rest 0 sec. Breathe out into the position without pushing the knees downward.

  • 45 sec {{exercise:1511:hamstring stretch}} — tempo still, gentle hold with knees soft; rest 0 sec. Breathe out into the position and avoid forcing the range.

  • 45 sec {{exercise:0690:seated lower back stretch}} — tempo still, comfortable hold; rest 0 sec. Breathe out into the position without pulling or bouncing.

  • 2 min Box breathing — 4 in, 4 hold, 4 out, 4 hold

name: Advanced Power Pilates
main_workout:
🧽 Soft Tissue Preparation 1'

  • Self-massage — 30 sec total using gentle hand pressure over the outer hips; avoid bony areas.

  • Self-massage — 30 sec total using light hand pressure over the forearms; keep wrists relaxed.

🔥 Activation 3'

  • 30 sec {{exercise:1428:wrist circles}} — move gently for 3 sec in each direction; rest 10 sec.

  • 10 reps {{exercise:pilates-roll-up:Roll-up}} — take 2 sec to lengthen forward and 2 sec to return, using a small comfortable range; rest 10 sec.

  • 10 reps {{exercise:pilates-corkscrew:Corkscrew}} — alternate sides, taking 2 sec to reach and 2 sec to return; keep the reach short and easy; rest 10 sec.

  • 10 reps {{exercise:pilates-hip-twist:Hip Twist}} — take 2 sec to articulate upward and 2 sec to return, staying well below fatigue; rest 10 sec.

💪 Main Workout (REPS & SETS)

Complete straight sets of each movement before continuing. Prescribed work and recovery total approximately 34 min 55 sec. Rest after every set, including the final set of each movement; use that final recovery to change position. Begin each set with a quiet inhale into the sides of the ribs, then exhale through the effort. Finish with 1–2 technically clean reps in reserve.

  • 3 sets × 10 reps {{exercise:pilates-roll-over:Roll-over}} — alternate legs, 5 reps per side; tempo 2-sec small leg lift, 2-sec controlled hold, 3-sec return; rest 45 sec. Keep the chest open and pelvis level; use a low lift rather than chasing height. Stop the set if wrists, shoulders or lower back become uncomfortable.

  • 3 sets × 10 reps {{exercise:pilates-neck-pull:Neck Pull}} — alternate sides, 5 reps per side; tempo 3-sec reach, 1-sec pause, 3-sec return; rest 45 sec. Lengthen the moving limbs only as far as you can without changing your rib or pelvic position.

  • 3 sets × 10 reps {{exercise:pilates-jackknife:Jackknife}} — tempo 2-sec gentle pelvic lift, 2-sec pause, 3-sec return; rest 45 sec. Keep knees bent and the movement small; initiate from the lower abdomen without swinging the legs or loading the neck.

  • 3 sets × 10 reps {{exercise:pilates-boomerang:Boomerang}} — tempo 3-sec sequential lift, 1-sec pause, 3-sec sequential return; rest 45 sec. Maintain even foot pressure and finish the lift before the ribs flare; keep weight away from the neck.

  • 2 sets × 10 reps per side {{exercise:pilates-control-balance:Control Balance}} — tempo 3-sec lift, 1-sec pause, 3-sec lower; rest 45 sec after completing both sides. Keep the pelvis stacked and toes facing forward; use the final recovery to change sides or position without rushing.

  • 3 sets × 10 reps {{exercise:pilates-single-leg-circle:Single Leg Circle}} — tempo 3-sec controlled forward articulation, 1-sec pause, 3-sec return to tall sitting; rest 45 sec. Keep knees softly bent if needed, lengthen through the crown of the head and avoid forcing the end range.

🧘 Cool Down 3'

  • 30 sec per side {{exercise:1424:seated glute stretch}} — ease into a still, comfortable position and breathe out gently; rest 5 sec between sides.

  • 30 sec {{exercise:1494:butterfly yoga pose}} — hold without bouncing or pushing the knees down; breathe out into the position; rest 5 sec.

  • 30 sec {{exercise:0690:seated lower back stretch}} — settle gradually into a mild, still position and breathe out slowly; rest 5 sec.

  • 2 min Box breathing — 4 in, 4 hold, 4 out, 4 hold

name: Arc Furnace
main_workout:
🧽 Soft Tissue Preparation 1'

  • Foam roll thighs — 30 sec total; move slowly with light pressure, avoiding knees.

  • Foam roll glutes — 30 sec total; divide time evenly between sides and avoid painful spots.

🔥 Activation 2'

  • 20 sec {{exercise:1167:dynamic chest stretch}} — 1 set; gently open and close the arms at an easy rhythm; rest 10 sec.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:1428:wrist circles}} — 1 set; slow, comfortable rotations, changing direction halfway; rest 10 sec.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:1363:spine stretch}} — 1 set; ease into a comfortable range and return slowly without holding; rest 10 sec.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:3360:Bear Crawl}} — 1 set; very slow, short steps with minimal knee clearance; stay well below fatigue; rest 10 sec.

💪 Main Workout (TABATA)

Complete four 4-minute blocks in this order: A, B, A, C. Each block contains 8 alternating intervals of 20 sec work / 10 sec rest, so each movement receives 4 intervals per block. Take an additional 30 sec recovery after blocks 1, 2 and 4. Total: 16 min intervals + 90 sec recovery = 17 min 30 sec. Keep one light pair of dumbbells beside your floor space.

Block A — alternate these two lines; perform this block twice in the stated schedule.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:1459:Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift}} — 4 intervals per A block, 8 total; lower for 2 sec and stand smoothly for 1 sec; keep the weights close and knees softly bent; rest 10 sec after every interval.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:1700:Dumbbell Push Press}} — 4 intervals per A block, 8 total; use a shallow knee dip, rise smoothly and lower under control for 2 sec; avoid leaning backward; rest 10 sec after every interval.

Block B — alternate these two lines for 8 intervals.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:0293:Dumbbell Bent-over Row}} — 4 intervals; pull smoothly for 1 sec and lower for 2 sec, keeping your trunk still; rest 10 sec after every interval.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:0514:Squat Jump}} — 4 intervals; use low jumps, land quietly and reset your balance before each repetition; maintain a smooth, repeatable pace rather than chasing height; rest 10 sec after every interval.

Block C — alternate these two lines for 8 intervals.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:1160:Burpee}} — 4 intervals; step back and forward, omit the jump and keep every repetition smooth; finish standing tall without rushing; rest 10 sec after every interval.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:1311:Wide Push-Up}} — 4 intervals; position hands only slightly wider than shoulders, lower for 2 sec and rise smoothly for 1 sec; retain 2 clean repetitions in reserve; rest 10 sec after every interval.

⚡ Finisher (For Time)

Set a 5-minute clock and complete 3 rounds of the four movements below: 20 sec work, 5 sec transition, 20 sec rest between rounds. This caps off the session — strong but controlled.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:1459:Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift}} — lower for 2 sec and stand smoothly for 1 sec, using the same light weights.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:0293:Dumbbell Bent-over Row}} — pull smoothly for 1 sec and lower for 2 sec without rocking.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:1160:Burpee}} — continue the step-back, step-forward version without a jump at an even, repeatable pace.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:0685:run}} — lift gently for 1 sec and lower for 2 sec, keeping the neck relaxed and range small.

🧘 Cool Down 2'30''

  • 20 sec {{exercise:0613:lying (side) quads stretch}} per side — 1 hold each side; remain still and breathe out into the position; rest 0 sec between sides.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:1424:seated glute stretch}} per side — 1 hold each side; remain still without forcing the knee; breathe out into the position; rest 0 sec between sides.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:0669:rear deltoid stretch}} per side — 1 hold each side; keep shoulders relaxed and breathe out into the position; rest 0 sec between sides.

Breathe quietly for 30 sec: inhale for approximately 4 sec and exhale for 6 sec, without holding your breath.

name: Iron Current
main_workout:
🧽 Soft Tissue Preparation 2'

  • Foam roll upper back — 1 × 60 sec, slow passes with your head supported; avoid the neck and lower back; rest 0 sec.

  • Foam roll outer upper back — 1 × 30 sec per side, gentle passes without direct pressure into the armpit; rest 0 sec.

🔥 Activation 4'

  • 1 set × 10 reps {{exercise:1167:dynamic chest stretch}} — open and return over 4 sec per repetition, using a comfortable range; rest 15 sec.

  • 1 set × 6 reps per side {{exercise:0669:rear deltoid stretch}} — gently enter for 2 sec and release for 2 sec, without a sustained hold; rest 15 sec.

  • 1 set × 8 reps {{exercise:1405:back pec stretch}} — gently enter for 2 sec and release for 2 sec; keep ribs relaxed and shoulders comfortable; rest 15 sec.

  • 1 set × 8 reps each direction {{exercise:1428:wrist circles}} — move both wrists together, taking 2 sec per repetition; rest 15 sec.

💪 Main Workout (REPS & SETS)

Complete each exercise block before moving on; these are straight sets, not supersets. Use a securely fitted loading belt with plates, leaving 2 repetitions in reserve. Blocks three and four repeat the established movements with approximately 5–10% less added load. Budget approximately 44 minutes including the written recovery periods; use the final recovery of each block to change position.

  • 4 sets × 3 reps {{exercise:0652:Pull-Up}} — externally loaded; tempo 2-sec lower, brief half-second pause, lift with explosive intent without swinging, 1-sec reset; rest 150 sec after every set. Use a comfortable shoulder-width grip and keep your neck neutral.

  • 4 sets × 3 reps {{exercise:1430:chest dip (on dip-pull-up cage)}} — externally loaded; tempo 2-sec lower, brief half-second pause, lift with explosive intent, 1-sec reset; rest 150 sec after every set. Descend only as far as your shoulders remain comfortable and controlled.

  • 4 sets × 4 reps {{exercise:3667:side lying hip adduction}} — externally loaded back-off block; tempo 2-sec lower, brief half-second pause, lift with explosive intent without swinging, 1-sec reset; rest 150 sec after every set. Reduce added load enough to retain 2 repetitions in reserve.

name: Keystone Press
main_workout:
🧽 Soft Tissue Preparation 2'

  • Foam roll glutes — 30 sec each side; move slowly with gentle contact, avoiding bony areas.

  • Foam roll upper back — 45 sec total; support your head and avoid the neck and lower back.

🔥 Activation 3'

  • 1 set × 10 reps {{exercise:1167:dynamic chest stretch}} — open and return over 3 sec per rep without forcing the range; rest 15 sec.

  • 1 set × 20 sec {{exercise:1428:wrist circles}} — smooth, small movements, changing direction halfway; rest 10 sec.

  • 1 set × 6 reps each side {{exercise:0669:rear deltoid stretch}} — gently enter and release over 3 sec per rep, without sustained holds; rest 10 sec.

  • 1 set × 8 reps {{exercise:1363:spine stretch}} — gently reach and return over 4 sec per rep within a comfortable range; rest 15 sec.

💪 Main Workout (REPS & SETS)

Complete straight sets in the listed order; do not alternate exercises. Use dumbbells and one adjustable bench. Keep 2 reps in reserve throughout. The prescribed work and recovery budget is approximately 40 minutes; use the recovery after each final set to change position and adjust the bench.

  • 5 sets × 4 reps {{exercise:1459:Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift}} — tempo 2-sec lower, 1-sec pause, lift with explosive intent over approximately 1 sec, 1-sec reset; rest 150 sec. Keep knees softly bent, weights close and your spine steady; stop descending before your back position changes.

  • 4 sets × 4 reps {{exercise:0426:dumbbell standing overhead press}} — tempo 2-sec lower, 1-sec pause, lift with explosive intent over approximately 1 sec, 1-sec reset; rest 120 sec. Keep ribs stacked over your pelvis and avoid leaning backward.

  • 4 sets × 4 reps {{exercise:0314:Dumbbell Incline Press}} — tempo 2-sec lower, 1-sec pause, lift with explosive intent over approximately 1 sec, 1-sec reset; rest 120 sec. Set the bench at 30–45 degrees, plant your feet and keep your shoulders supported.

  • 2 sets × 5 reps {{exercise:0296:dumbbell close-grip press}} — tempo 2-sec lower, 1-sec pause, lift with explosive intent over approximately 1 sec, 1-sec reset; rest 120 sec. Flatten the bench and keep elbows comfortably near your sides.

  • 1 set × 6 reps {{exercise:0330:dumbbell incline triceps extension}} — tempo 2-sec lower, 1-sec pause, smooth 1-sec extension, 1-sec reset; rest 120 sec. Return the bench to a comfortable incline; use a moderate load and keep upper arms steady.

⚡ Finisher (REPS & SETS)

Approximately 5 minutes. These are three controlled accessory sets, not a circuit or conditioning test. Stay at the same incline bench, use lighter dumbbells and retain 2 clean reps in reserve. Reduce the load for the final exercise as needed to accommodate the additional repetitions.

  • 1 set × 8 reps {{exercise:0319:dumbbell incline fly}} — tempo 2-sec lower, 1-sec comfortable pause, smooth 1-sec return, 1-sec reset; rest 60 sec. Maintain softly bent elbows and stop before the shoulders feel strained.

  • 1 set × 8 reps {{exercise:0328:dumbbell incline shoulder raise}} — tempo 2-sec return, 1-sec pause, smooth 1-sec reach, 1-sec reset; rest 60 sec. Keep elbows straight without locking; use a small shoulder-blade movement rather than bending the arms.

  • 1 set × 8 reps {{exercise:0330:dumbbell incline triceps extension}} — tempo 2-sec lower, 1-sec pause, smooth 1-sec extension, 1-sec reset; rest 60 sec. Keep the movement comfortable at the elbows and finish without grinding.

🧘 Cool Down 4'

  • 1 set × 30 sec each side {{exercise:1271:chest and front of shoulder stretch}} — hold still at mild tension and breathe out into the position; rest 5 sec between sides.

  • 1 set × 30 sec each side {{exercise:1511:hamstring stretch}} — hold still without rounding forcefully or bouncing; rest 5 sec between sides.

  • 1 set × 30 sec each side {{exercise:1424:seated glute stretch}} — hold still and breathe out into the position; rest 5 sec between sides.

  • 2 min Box breathing — 4 in, 4 hold, 4 out, 4 hold

name: Intermediate Core Balance
main_workout:
🧽 Soft Tissue Preparation 1'

  • Self-massage — 30 sec total across the outer hips using gentle hand contact; avoid bony points.

  • Self-massage — 30 sec total across the thighs using relaxed palms; keep the sensation comfortable.

🔥 Activation 3'

  • 30 sec {{exercise:1422:pelvic tilt into bridge}} — gently articulate upward over 3 sec and downward over 3 sec; rest 15 sec.

  • 30 sec {{exercise:0276:Dead Bug}} — alternate short reaches, taking 3 sec outward and 3 sec back; keep breathing comfortably; rest 15 sec.

  • 30 sec {{exercise:0710:side hip abduction}} — 15 sec per side, lifting for 2 sec and lowering for 3 sec through a small range; rest 15 sec.

  • 30 sec {{exercise:1363:spine stretch}} — gently lengthen forward for 3 sec and return for 3 sec without forcing range; rest 15 sec.

💪 Main Workout (REPS & SETS)

Complete all sets of each exercise before continuing. Prescribed repetitions and rests total 34 min 7 sec; allow approximately 53 sec overall for position changes, bringing the main workout to 35 min. Include the final prescribed rest on each line. Before the first repetition, settle your ribs over your pelvis and establish relaxed, continuous breathing.

  • 3 sets × 8 reps {{exercise:the-hundred:The Hundred}} — tempo 3-sec controlled lift, 1-sec pause, 3-sec lower, 1-sec reset; rest 45 sec after each set. Exhale as the shoulder blades leave the floor; keep the neck long and avoid pulling the head forward.

  • 2 sets × 10 reps {{exercise:pilates-rolling-like-a-ball:Rolling Like A Ball}} — tempo 3-sec gradual rise, 1-sec pause, 3-sec articulated return, 1-sec reset; rest 45 sec after each set. Reach forward without throwing the arms or using momentum; use only the range you can reverse smoothly.

  • 3 sets × 10 reps {{exercise:pilates-swan-dive:Swan Dive}} — alternate sides for 5 reps per side per set; tempo 2-sec foot lift, 2-sec steady hold, 2-sec foot return; rest 45 sec after each set. Keep the pelvis level and the supporting foot grounded; lower fully during each rest.

  • 2 sets × 10 reps per side {{exercise:pilates-scissors:Scissors}} — tempo 2-sec hip lift, 1-sec pause, 3-sec lower; rest 45 sec after each side, including the final side. Complete both sides to finish one set; stop the lift before the lower back arches.

  • 2 sets × 10 reps per side {{exercise:pilates-leg-pull-back:Leg Pull Back}} — tempo 2-sec hip lift, 1-sec pause, 3-sec controlled lower; rest 45 sec after each side, including the final side. Complete both sides to finish one set; keep the supporting elbow beneath the shoulder and lift without rotating.

  • 3 sets × 10 reps {{exercise:pilates-chest-lift-rotation:Chest Lift With Rotation}} — one rep is one left-leg lift and one right-leg lift; take 3 sec to lift and return each leg, giving 6 sec per rep; rest 45 sec after each set. Keep the movement small, the pelvis quiet and the neck aligned; reach the legs long rather than lifting them high.

🧘 Cool Down 3'

  • 30 sec per side {{exercise:0613:lying (side) quads stretch}} — hold still at mild tension and breathe out into the position; rest 5 sec to change position.

  • 30 sec per side {{exercise:1424:seated glute stretch}} — maintain a comfortable, steady hold and breathe out into the position; rest 5 sec to change position.

  • 30 sec {{exercise:1363:spine stretch}} — hold a gentle forward lengthening position without bouncing; breathe out into the position; rest 5 sec.

15 sec relaxed breathing — inhale gently through the nose and let each exhale soften the abdomen and shoulders.

name: Ember Step Ladder
main_workout:
🧽 Soft Tissue Preparation 1'

  • Self-massage — 30 sec total across both thighs using your palms; apply gentle pressure and avoid the knees.

  • Self-massage — 30 sec total across both calves while seated on the floor; use slow hand strokes without digging into tender areas.

🔥 Activation 3'

  • 30 sec {{exercise:1167:dynamic chest stretch}} — 1 set; gently open and close your arms at a relaxed pace; rest 15 sec.

  • 30 sec {{exercise:1428:wrist circles}} — 1 set; move slowly through comfortable ranges, changing direction halfway; rest 15 sec.

  • 30 sec {{exercise:1368:Ankle Circles}} — 1 set; seated on the floor, alternate ankles with small, unhurried movements; rest 15 sec.

  • 30 sec {{exercise:1422:pelvic tilt into bridge}} — 1 set; gently lift and lower with easy breathing, without tiring the muscles; rest 15 sec.

💪 Main Workout (AMRAP)

Time cap: 26 min. Repeat the six movements in order for as many comfortable rounds as possible, keeping every recovery period. Each station uses 30 sec for the prescribed repetitions followed by 60 sec rest, including transitions. One full round takes 9 min: complete two rounds, then continue through the remaining 8 min. Stop at the cap; do not add a final recovery beyond it.

  • 10 reps {{exercise:3533:quads (bodyweight squat)}} — per round, over 30 sec; lower for 2 sec and stand for 1 sec at a smooth, repeatable pace. Use a comfortable depth and keep heels grounded; rest 60 sec.

  • 10 reps {{exercise:3166:bodyweight standing row}} — per round, over 30 sec; draw elbows back for 1 sec and return for 2 sec, gently engaging your upper back without an anchor or implement. Keep shoulders relaxed and movement smooth; rest 60 sec.

  • 10 reps {{exercise:3211:Kneeling Push-Up}} — per round, over 30 sec; lower for 2 sec and return for 1 sec at a smooth, repeatable pace. Keep knees grounded and shorten the depth as needed to retain 2 good repetitions in reserve; rest 60 sec.

  • 10 reps {{exercise:0685:run}} — per round, over 30 sec; lift for 1 sec and lower for 2 sec at a smooth, repeatable pace. Keep ribs relaxed and finish with the hips rather than arching the back; rest 60 sec.

  • 10 reps {{exercise:0630:Mountain Climber}} — per round, over 30 sec; alternate 5 controlled knee movements per side, taking 3 sec to bring each knee forward and return. Keep hips steady, use short steps and never hop; rest 60 sec.

  • 10 reps {{exercise:2466:bridge - mountain climber (cross body)}} — per round, over 30 sec; alternate 5 repetitions per side, taking 3 sec to extend and return smoothly. Keep the range short enough that your lower back stays comfortable; rest 60 sec.

⚡ Finisher (5 minutes)

Set a 5-minute clock and complete 3 clean rounds of the movements below. This caps off the session — keep the pace strong but controlled and stop the clock at 5 minutes.

  • 10 reps {{exercise:1685:squat to overhead reach}}

  • 30 sec {{exercise:3360:Bear Crawl}}

  • 30 sec {{exercise:1160:Burpee}}

🧘 Cool Down 3'

  • 30 sec per side {{exercise:0669:rear deltoid stretch}} — 1 set; hold gently without bouncing and breathe out into the position; rest 0 sec between sides.

  • 30 sec per side {{exercise:0613:lying (side) quads stretch}} — 1 set; keep the knees comfortably aligned, hold still and breathe out into the position; rest 0 sec between sides.

  • 30 sec {{exercise:1494:butterfly yoga pose}} — 1 set; sit comfortably without forcing the knees downward, hold still and breathe out into the position; rest 0 sec.

  • 2 min Box breathing — 4 in, 4 hold, 4 out, 4 hold

name: Cadence Coil Tabata
main_workout:
🧽 Soft Tissue Preparation 1'

  • Foam roll calves — 30 sec total, moving slowly with light pressure.

  • Foam roll upper back — 30 sec, supporting your head and avoiding direct pressure on your neck and lower back.

🔥 Activation 4'

  • 20 sec {{exercise:1167:dynamic chest stretch}} — 2 sets; gently open and close your arms without bouncing; rest 10 sec after each set.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:1428:wrist circles}} — 2 sets; make small, comfortable movements, reversing direction halfway; rest 10 sec after each set.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:1422:pelvic tilt into bridge}} — 2 sets; lift for 2 sec and lower for 2 sec without arching your back; rest 10 sec after each set.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:1368:Ankle Circles}} — 2 sets; move slowly, using one ankle per set; rest 10 sec after each set.

💪 Main Workout (TABATA)

30 minutes total. Complete seven 4-minute blocks: run the A, B, C, C sequence, then repeat blocks A, B and C once more. Each block contains 8 rounds of 20 sec work / 10 sec rest, alternating its two listed lines. Take an additional 20 sec between blocks. Total: 7 × 4 min + 6 × 20 sec = 30 min. Use one combined bodyweight support station with adjacent clear floor space. These are controlled intervals, not maximal-effort tests.

Block A — controlled upper-body strength. Alternate the following two lines for 8 intervals total. Use light foot support on a secure, fixed platform when necessary to preserve two repetitions in reserve.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:1772:elbow lift - reverse push-up}} — 4 intervals; lift smoothly for about 2 sec and lower for 3 sec, without swinging; rest 10 sec after each interval. Stop repetitions early if your next repetition would require momentum.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:0806:suspended push-up}} — 4 intervals; lower for 3 sec and rise smoothly for 2 sec; rest 10 sec after each interval. Keep shoulders controlled and use only a comfortable depth, with upper arms no deeper than approximately parallel to the floor.

Block B — repeatable strength. Alternate the following two lines for 8 intervals total. Retain the same assistance and range; match Block A's clean repetitions rather than chasing fatigue.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:0969:band alternating v-up}} — 4 intervals; lift for about 2 sec and lower for 3 sec, maintaining a quiet trunk; rest 10 sec after each interval. Increase foot assistance if needed to keep two repetitions in reserve.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:0806:suspended push-up}} — 4 intervals; lower for 3 sec and rise for 2 sec through the same comfortable range; rest 10 sec after each interval. Keep your neck relaxed and stop before shoulder position changes.

Blocks C and D — conditioning and trunk control. Perform the following pair as one 8-interval block, take the scheduled 20 sec recovery, then repeat the block once. Move to the adjacent floor area and remain there for the rest of the session.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:0501:jack burpee}} — 4 intervals per block, 2 blocks; use the low-impact version: step back and forward, then step feet out and in instead of jumping; rest 10 sec after each interval. Move at a smooth, repeatable pace without an additional arm-lowering repetition.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:0508:janda sit-up}} — 4 intervals per block, 2 blocks; keep feet planted, gently draw heels toward you, rise for 2 sec and lower for 3 sec; rest 10 sec after each interval. Use a shorter range if necessary and never pull on your neck.

⚡ Finisher (5 minutes)

Set a 5-minute clock and complete 3 clean rounds of the movements below. This caps off the session — keep the pace strong but controlled and stop the clock at 5 minutes.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:0501:jack burpee}}

  • 20 sec {{exercise:0508:janda sit-up}}

🧘 Cool Down 3'

  • 20 sec {{exercise:0613:lying (side) quads stretch}} — 1 hold per side; remain still with knees comfortably aligned, breathe out into the position, then allow 10 sec to change position.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:1424:seated glute stretch}} — 1 hold per side; hold without bouncing or forcing the knee, breathe out into the position, then allow 10 sec to change position.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:1346:kneeling lat stretch}} — 2 gentle holds; remain still and breathe out into the position, allowing 10 sec total between holds and for repositioning.

Breathe comfortably for 30 sec: inhale for approximately 4 sec and exhale for approximately 6 sec, without holding your breath.

  • Self-massage front and outer thighs with your palms — 30 sec total, gentle continuous pressure, 15 sec each side; avoid joints.

🔥 Activation 3'

  • 30 sec {{exercise:1422:pelvic tilt into bridge}} — 1 set; lift gently for 2 sec and lower for 2 sec; rest 15 sec.

  • 30 sec {{exercise:0710:side hip abduction}} — 1 set, 15 sec each side; lift and lower slowly through a comfortable range; rest 15 sec.

  • 30 sec {{exercise:1368:Ankle Circles}} — 1 set, 15 sec each side while seated; make slow, comfortable rotations in both directions; rest 15 sec.

  • 30 sec {{exercise:1167:dynamic chest stretch}} — 1 set; open and close the arms gently without bouncing; rest 15 sec.

💪 Main Workout (EMOM)

18 minutes total: 3 rounds of the following 6-minute sequence. Start each station on the minute, work for 35 sec and rest for 25 sec. Each listed station is completed 3 times. Repeated movements deliberately keep the sequence familiar. Maintain an effort of 5–6 out of 10 and the ability to speak a sentence.

  • Minute 1: 35 sec {{exercise:2271:left hook (boxing)}} — smooth, repeatable pace; use light, relaxed punches into open air, pivot comfortably and return to guard each time; rest 25 sec.

  • Minute 2: 35 sec {{exercise:3219:scissor jumps}} — smooth, repeatable pace; use a narrow front-to-back foot exchange, minimal height and soft knees rather than deep split positions; rest 25 sec.

  • Minute 3: 35 sec {{exercise:3361:skater hops}} — smooth, repeatable pace; keep lateral distance short, land quietly and establish control before the next hop; rest 25 sec.

  • Minute 4: 35 sec {{exercise:pilates-push-up:Pilates Push-Up}} — smooth, repeatable pace; keep the shoulders relaxed and punches light, with comfortable whole-body rotation rather than forceful twisting; rest 25 sec.

  • Minute 5: 35 sec {{exercise:3219:scissor jumps}} — smooth, repeatable pace; maintain the same small foot exchange and quiet landing quality as Minute 2; rest 25 sec, including the transition to the floor.

  • Minute 6: 35 sec {{exercise:3360:Bear Crawl}} — smooth, repeatable pace; take two small steps forward and two backward, keeping hips level and breathing freely; rest 25 sec, including a controlled return to standing.

⚡ Finisher (5 minutes)

name: Kinetic Vortex Tabata
main_workout:
🧽 Soft Tissue Preparation 2'

  • Foam roll calves — 40 sec total, moving slowly with light pressure.

  • Foam roll thighs — 40 sec total, avoiding the knees.

  • Foam roll upper back — 40 sec, supporting your head and avoiding the neck and lower back.

🔥 Activation 3'

  • 20 sec {{exercise:1368:Ankle Circles}} — 2 sets, dividing each interval equally between sides; gentle continuous movement; rest 5 sec after each set.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:1422:pelvic tilt into bridge}} — 2 sets; lift smoothly, pause briefly, then lower under control; rest 5 sec after each set.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:1167:dynamic chest stretch}} — 2 sets; use small, relaxed movements without forcing the shoulders; rest 5 sec after each set.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:1428:wrist circles}} — 1 set; slow comfortable rotations; rest 10 sec before training.

💪 Main Workout (TABATA)

30 minutes total. Complete blocks A, B, C, then repeat the whole A, B, C sequence, finishing with a final block C. Each block is 8 rounds of 20 sec work / 10 sec rest, alternating its two listed movements for four intervals each. Take an additional 20 sec between blocks: 7 × 4 minutes + 6 × 20 sec = 30 minutes. Use a combined fixed-bar station first, then move once to your dumbbells and floor space.

Block A — controlled upper-body work. These are submaximal intervals, not maximum-repetition tests. Use only movements you already perform confidently.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:0685:run}} — 4 intervals; perform 2–4 clean repetitions, then recover for any remaining work time; rise smoothly and lower for 2 sec without swinging; rest 10 sec after each interval.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:2466:bridge - mountain climber (cross body)}} — 4 intervals; perform 3–5 controlled repetitions, then recover for any remaining work time; lower for 2 sec and rise smoothly, stopping before the shoulders roll forward; rest 10 sec after each interval.

Block B — repeat the familiar pattern with fewer repetitions. Maintain the same technique despite accumulating fatigue.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:0685:run}} — 4 intervals; perform 1–3 clean repetitions, then recover for the remaining work time; rise smoothly and lower for 2 sec without swinging; rest 10 sec after each interval.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:2466:bridge - mountain climber (cross body)}} — 4 intervals; perform 2–4 controlled repetitions, then recover for the remaining work time; lower for 2 sec and rise smoothly through a comfortable range; rest 10 sec after each interval.

Block C — full-body conditioning. Complete this block twice, with the scheduled 20 sec additional recovery between appearances. Keep the dumbbells very light and beside your floor space.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:0371:dumbbell plyo squat}} — 4 intervals per block, 8 total; perform 3–4 small, crisp repetitions with a complete reset after each quiet landing; lower under control and rise briskly; rest 10 sec after each interval.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:0501:jack burpee}} — 4 intervals per block, 8 total; maintain a smooth repeatable pace; step the feet back and forward and use low-impact side steps instead of jumping when needed; rest 10 sec after each interval.

⚡ Finisher (5 minutes)

Set a 5-minute clock and complete 3 clean rounds of the movements below. This caps off the session — keep the pace strong but controlled and stop the clock at 5 minutes.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:0501:jack burpee}}

  • 20 sec {{exercise:1201:dumbbell burpee}}

  • 20 sec {{exercise:bw-reverse-lunge:Reverse Lunge}}

🧘 Cool Down 3'

  • 20 sec {{exercise:1398:Standing Calf Stretch}} — 1 hold per side; settle gradually without bouncing and breathe out into the position; allow 5 sec to change sides.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:0613:lying (side) quads stretch}} — 1 hold per side; keep the pelvis comfortable, settle gradually and breathe out into the position; allow 5 sec to change sides.

  • 20 sec {{exercise:0669:rear deltoid stretch}} — 1 hold per side; keep the shoulder relaxed, hold still and breathe out into the position; allow 5 sec to change sides.

  • 2 min Box breathing — 4 in, 4 hold, 4 out, 4 hold

name: Helix Integration
main_workout:
🧽 Soft Tissue Preparation 2'

  • Self-massage — 30 sec per thigh using your palms; apply gentle pressure over muscle, avoiding the knees.

  • Self-massage — 30 sec per upper arm and shoulder using the opposite hand; avoid direct pressure over joints.

🔥 Activation 4'

  • 1 set × 8 reps {{exercise:1167:dynamic chest stretch}} — tempo 2 sec open, 2 sec return; use an easy range; rest 15 sec.

  • 1 set × 8 reps {{exercise:1428:wrist circles}} — tempo 2 sec per rotation, four each direction; rest 15 sec.

  • 1 set × 8 reps {{exercise:1422:pelvic tilt into bridge}} — tempo 2 sec lift, 1 sec gentle hold, 2 sec lower; rest 20 sec.

  • 1 set × 6 reps per side {{exercise:0710:side hip abduction}} — tempo 2 sec lift, 2 sec lower; keep effort easy; rest 20 sec.

💪 Main Workout (REPS & SETS)

Complete all four sets of each exercise before moving on. Allow approximately 45 minutes, including the prescribed recovery after every set and transitions within those recovery periods. Keep 2–3 clean reps in reserve; this is deliberate strength practice, not a circuit.

  • 4 sets × 3 reps {{exercise:0778:spider crawl push up}} — tempo 2-sec lower, 1-sec pause, rise with fast intent while keeping hands grounded, 1-sec reset; rest 150 sec. Alternate the advancing knee, keep its travel modest and prevent trunk rotation; alternate your starting side each set.

  • 4 sets × 3 reps {{exercise:3663:reverse plank with leg lift}} — tempo 1-sec controlled leg lift, 1-sec hold, 2-sec lower, 1-sec reset; rest 150 sec. Alternate legs and your starting side each set; keep the pelvis level and use only a pain-free shoulder position.

  • 4 sets × 3 reps per side {{exercise:1775:side plank hip adduction}} — tempo 1-sec controlled lift, 1-sec hold, 2-sec lower, 1-sec reset; rest 150 sec after both sides. Use the floor-supported position without elevating either foot on furniture; keep the supporting shoulder steady and the movement small.

  • 4 sets × 3 reps {{exercise:0508:janda sit-up}} — tempo 1-sec smooth rise, 1-sec pause, 2-sec lower, 1-sec reset; rest 150 sec. Keep feet unanchored, gently draw the heels toward you without sliding, and avoid momentum or neck pulling.

⚡ Finisher (REPS & SETS)

One low-fatigue accessory set per movement, approximately 2½ minutes total. These are separate quality sets, not conditioning; retain at least 3 reps in reserve.

  • 1 set × 3 reps {{exercise:3663:reverse plank with leg lift}} — tempo 1-sec lift, 1-sec hold, 2-sec lower, 1-sec reset; rest 30 sec. Alternate legs without letting the hips drop.

  • 1 set × 3 reps per side {{exercise:1775:side plank hip adduction}} — tempo 1-sec lift, 1-sec hold, 2-sec lower, 1-sec reset; rest 30 sec after both sides. Maintain the same floor-supported setup and comfortable range.

  • 1 set × 3 reps {{exercise:0508:janda sit-up}} — tempo 1-sec smooth rise, 1-sec pause, 2-sec lower, 1-sec reset; rest 30 sec. Keep the feet unanchored and finish before technique changes.

🧘 Cool Down 4'

  • 1 set × 30 sec per side {{exercise:0669:rear deltoid stretch}} — hold gently without bouncing and breathe out into the position; rest 5 sec between sides.

  • 1 set × 45 sec {{exercise:1511:hamstring stretch}} — hold a comfortable position without rounding forcefully; breathe out into the position; rest 5 sec.

  • 2 min Box breathing — 4 in, 4 hold, 4 out, 4 hold

name: Metabolic Surge
main_workout:
🧽 Soft Tissue Preparation 2'

  • Foam roll thighs — 30 sec total, moving slowly with comfortable contact.

  • Foam roll glutes — 30 sec total, dividing time evenly between sides.

  • Foam roll calves — 30 sec total, avoiding direct contact over joints.

  • Foam roll upper back — 30 sec, supporting your head and avoiding the neck and lower back.

🔥 Activation 3'

  • 30 sec {{exercise:1167:dynamic chest stretch}} — 1 set; open and return gently over 3 sec; rest 15 sec.

  • 30 sec {{exercise:1428:wrist circles}} — 1 set; make small, comfortable rotations, changing direction halfway; rest 15 sec.

  • 30 sec {{exercise:1363:spine stretch}} — 1 set; gently reach forward from the hips and return over 5 sec, without forcing range; rest 15 sec.

  • 30 sec {{exercise:1346:kneeling lat stretch}} — 1 set; ease the hips backward and return slowly over 5 sec, keeping the shoulders comfortable; rest 15 sec.

💪 Main Workout (EMOM)

30 minutes: 5 rounds of the following 6-minute sequence. Repeat Minutes 1–6 five times. Each minute contains 40 sec of work and 20 sec of rest, including transitions. Use moderate loads and finish each resistance interval with 1–2 technically sound reps available. Keep the kettlebells beside one clear floor area.

  • Minute 1: 40 sec {{exercise:0549:Kettlebell Swing}} — 5 sets total; use a crisp hip extension and controlled return, letting the bell float no higher than chest height; rest 20 sec.

  • Minute 2: 40 sec {{exercise:0550:Kettlebell Thruster}} — 5 sets total; hold one bell with both hands, lower over 2 sec and rise into a smooth overhead finish without leaning backward; rest 20 sec.

  • Minute 3: 40 sec {{exercise:1345:Kettlebell Row}} — 5 sets total; draw both bells upward over 1 sec and lower over 2 sec, maintaining a steady torso; rest 20 sec.

  • Minute 4: 40 sec {{exercise:3360:Bear Crawl}} — 5 sets total; take slow, short steps forward and backward within a small area, keeping knees low and hips quiet; rest 20 sec.

  • Minute 5: 40 sec {{exercise:0267:crunch (hands overhead)}} — 5 sets total; lift over 1 sec and lower over 2 sec through a small controlled range, without pulling the head forward; rest 20 sec.

  • Minute 6: 40 sec {{exercise:0687:russian twist}} — 5 sets total; keep feet grounded and turn gently from side to side over 2 sec per side, without rounding or forcing rotation; rest 20 sec.

⚡ Finisher (5 minutes)

Set a 5-minute clock and complete 3 clean rounds of the movements below. This caps off the session — keep the pace strong but controlled and stop the clock at 5 minutes.

  • 40 sec {{exercise:0549:Kettlebell Swing}}

  • 40 sec {{exercise:0550:Kettlebell Thruster}}

  • 40 sec {{exercise:1345:Kettlebell Row}}

  • 40 sec {{exercise:3360:Bear Crawl}}

🧘 Cool Down 3'

  • 40 sec {{exercise:0613:lying (side) quads stretch}} — 1 set, 20 sec per side; hold still at gentle tension and breathe out into the position; rest 10 sec.

  • 40 sec {{exercise:1511:hamstring stretch}} — 1 set, dividing time evenly if performed one side at a time; hold without bouncing and breathe out into the position; rest 10 sec.

  • 40 sec {{exercise:1271:chest and front of shoulder stretch}} — 1 set; hold at gentle tension without forcing the shoulders backward; rest 10 sec.

30 sec relaxed breathing — inhale gently for 4 sec and exhale for 6 sec, completing 3 cycles.

name: Cadence Current Weave
main_workout:
🧽 Soft Tissue Preparation 1'

  • Self-massage — 30 sec total across both calves using gentle hand pressure; avoid tender spots and the backs of the knees.

  • Self-massage — 30 sec total across the fronts of both thighs using broad palm pressure; keep the sensation comfortable.

🔥 Activation 3'

  • 30 sec {{exercise:1422:pelvic tilt into bridge}} — 1 set; lift and lower gently over about 3 sec per repetition; rest 15 sec.

  • 30 sec {{exercise:1368:Ankle Circles}} — 1 set, 15 sec per side; use slow, comfortable rotations; rest 15 sec.

  • 30 sec {{exercise:0257:circles knee stretch}} — 1 set; make small, unforced movements with soft knees; rest 15 sec.

  • 30 sec {{exercise:1428:wrist circles}} — 1 set; move gently in both directions without forcing range; rest 15 sec.

💪 Main Workout (EMOM)

30 minutes total: repeat the six-minute sequence for 5 rounds. Begin each station at the start of its minute, work for 35 sec and rest for 25 sec. Repeated stations are intentional: maintain the same comfortable cadence rather than increasing speed. Standing work stays together, followed by floor work in the same clear training area.

  • Minute 1: 35 sec {{exercise:3655:walking high knees lunge}} — 5 sets across the block; alternate sides with short steps and comfortable knee height; use a smooth, repeatable pace and rest 25 sec.

  • Minute 2: 35 sec {{exercise:pilates-push-up:Pilates Push-Up}} — 5 sets across the block; maintain the previous cadence with shallow, comfortable knee bends; use a smooth, repeatable pace and rest 25 sec.

  • Minute 3: 35 sec {{exercise:1775:side plank hip adduction}} — 5 sets across the block; place each foot quietly and keep the front knee aligned with the toes; use a smooth, repeatable pace and rest 25 sec.

  • Minute 4: 35 sec {{exercise:bw-reverse-lunge:Reverse Lunge}} — 5 sets across the block; keep the torso upright and avoid pushing for additional depth; use a smooth, repeatable pace and rest 25 sec.

  • Minute 5: 35 sec {{exercise:3360:Bear Crawl}} — 5 sets across the block; take very small forward and backward steps within your floor space, keeping hips steady; use a smooth, repeatable pace and rest 25 sec.

  • Minute 6: 35 sec {{exercise:3360:Bear Crawl}} — 5 sets across the block; repeat without speeding up, keeping the neck relaxed and breathing continuously; use a smooth, repeatable pace and rest 25 sec.

⚡ Finisher (5 minutes)

Set a 5-minute clock and complete 3 clean rounds of the movements below. This caps off the session — keep the pace strong but controlled and stop the clock at 5 minutes.

  • 40 sec {{exercise:3655:walking high knees lunge}}

  • 40 sec {{exercise:3360:Bear Crawl}}

🧘 Cool Down 3'

  • 40 sec {{exercise:1390:seated calf stretch}} — 1 set; hold gently without bouncing and breathe out into the position; rest 0 sec before transitioning.

  • 40 sec {{exercise:0613:lying (side) quads stretch}} — 1 set, 20 sec per side; hold a mild, steady position and breathe out slowly; rest 0 sec before transitioning.

  • 40 sec {{exercise:0669:rear deltoid stretch}} — 1 set, 20 sec per side; keep the shoulder relaxed and hold without bouncing; rest 0 sec before the breathing period.

  • 2 min Box breathing — 4 in, 4 hold, 4 out, 4 hold
